hospital_meaning: Validating 2 Mbps primary WAN sizing against combined ICU PACS Voice and Admin traffic
dependent_metrics: Throughput; Goodput; Mean Delay; 95th Percentile Delay; Queue Drop Count
theoretical_expectation: Throughput matches offered load until capacity threshold; queue drops and delay escalate exponentially when offered load exceeds bottleneck rate.

hospital_meaning: Ensuring life-critical ICU vitals survive heavy guest Wi-Fi and PACS bulk congestion
independent_vars: Queue Discipline: [DropTail RedQueueDisc PrioQueueDisc]; Competing Guest Load: [0.5 1.0 1.5 2.0 2.5 Mbps]
dependent_metrics: ICU Packet Loss Ratio; ICU Mean and 95th Percentile Delay; PACS Goodput; Queue Drops per Band
theoretical_expectation: Under DropTail ICU packets are dropped during burst congestion; under PrioQueueDisc ICU packets maintain near-zero drops and sub-30ms latency regardless of guest load.

hospital_meaning: Comparing TCP NewReno CUBIC and BBR during 5 MB MRI/CT transfers across lossy hospital WAN
independent_vars: TCP Variant: [TcpNewReno TcpCubic TcpBbr]; Link Loss Rate PER: [0.0% 0.1% 0.5% 1.0% 2.0% 5.0%]
dependent_metrics: Goodput; Transfer Time; Retransmission Count; CWND Evolution
theoretical_expectation: CUBIC achieves maximum goodput in clean links; BBR maintains significantly higher goodput in lossy links (PER >= 1%); NewReno collapses due to aggressive multiplicative backoff.

hospital_meaning: Measuring clinical telemetry drop runs and reconvergence time during primary WAN fiber cut
independent_vars: Primary WAN Down Event: t=12.0s; Outage Duration: [5s 10s 15s]; Routing Mode: [GlobalRouting SPF vs Static Failover]
dependent_metrics: Outage Duration; Failover Packet Loss; Jitter Spike; Post-Failover Delay
theoretical_expectation: Packets in flight during link teardown are dropped until SPF routing recalculates; post-failover delay rises to 25ms and throughput throttles to 1Mbps.

experiment_title: Clinical LAN Contention & CSMA Node Scaling
hospital_meaning: Evaluating 100 Mbps CSMA/CD access network scalability under increasing bedside sensor density
dependent_metrics: Aggregated Throughput; Packet Delivery Ratio; Mean Contention Delay; Backoff Counter Count
theoretical_expectation: CSMA/CD at 100 Mbps easily absorbs telemetry streams up to 50 nodes with PDR > 99.8%; backoff delays remain under 2ms.

hospital_meaning: Evaluating equitable bandwidth sharing among concurrent PACS transfers without starving Admin web
independent_vars: Concurrent TCP Flows: [2 4 6 8 flows]; Buffer Size: [20p 50p 100p 200p]
dependent_metrics: Jains Fairness Index; Per-flow Throughput Variance; Total Goodput
theoretical_expectation: Small buffers induce TCP global synchronization degrading fairness (J < 0.82); sizing buffer to BDP restores fairness to J >= 0.95.

experiment_title: Guest Wi-Fi DoS Flood & Anomaly Detection
hospital_meaning: Simulating high-rate rogue UDP flooding from Guest Wi-Fi and evaluating threshold-based detection
independent_vars: Attack Flood Rate: [0.5 1.0 2.0 5.0 Mbps]; Detection Threshold: [Z-score 2.0 2.5 3.0]
fixed_params: Normal ICU: 160kbps; Attack Start: t=10.0s; Sim Time: 25s
dependent_metrics: Precision; Recall; F1 Score; Detection Latency; ICU Telemetry Loss %
theoretical_expectation: Unmitigated DoS severely degrades ICU telemetry; statistical rate/Z-score anomaly filter detects and throttles rogue attack traffic within < 400ms with F1 >= 0.94.
